_comment: Beyond-W3C fixture for docs/fstar-extracted/index.html. Phase 1 (#242) populates this with all 33 queries by extracting from the HTML; this seed entry exists so Phase 2a (#243) has a concrete failing query to land its runner against. The bind-upper query is the canonical #240 reproducer.

queries.name: bind-upper

queries._status: fixed in #240; runners should now match native across native/js-node/wasm-node

expected._note: All 8 people. Fixed 2026-07-06: SPARQL11.Algebra.string_upper/string_lower now call the string_uppercase_unicode/string_lowercase_unicode assume vals, realised via the `uucp` opam package in minimal_regrettable_glue_code_each_with_an_open_issue/250_unicode_case_mapping.sh. 'Eve Müller' now upper-cases to 'EVE MÜLLER' (was 'EVE MüLLER'). Value-level pinning (incl. the harder 'straße'->'STRASSE' and Greek-sigma cases, which this dataset doesn't cover) lives in tests/unit/ucase_lcase_unicode.ml — this fixture only checks row-count since Phase 2a (#243)'s row-set comparison logic isn't implemented in bin/run-parity.py yet.
